KyoubeAI 1.16 turns the Team page into a living org chart.

## What's in 1.16.0

**An org chart at Team.** `/<company>/team` shows every agent as a card with its live state: working, waiting on you, needs attention, paused or idle. Each manager's reports sit in a team panel, and agents that report to no one yet sit on a "Not in a team yet" shelf. Click an agent to narrow the chart to it and its line; the side panel that opens has the **On duty** switch and **Assign task**. Teams can be folded, and a company with more than 60 agents opens folded. The chart refreshes every 15 seconds, and cards animate as work moves: when a task is finished, when it passes from one agent to another, and when an agent runs into a problem.

**Presentation mode for demos.** **Present**, or `?present=1` in the address, fills the screen and tours the organization one team at a time with a live caption. Space pauses, the arrow keys step and Esc leaves.

**The core's agent list is one click away.** The org icon next to **Team** opens the chart, and **List** on the chart opens the core's agent list. The 1.15 workaround that pressed the core's "Org chart view" button is gone.

## Update

From 1.15, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.15.0 from that backup. Nothing else to do: Kyoube Studio moves to 0.7.0 on the next start, and the core and its database are unchanged.

The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
